question: For one tooth's detection, what share of its explanation map falls inside that tooth's own box?
films: 8 DenPAR periapical test films (1, 100, 1000, 1007, 1027, 103, 1036, 1042) + 1 BRAR panoramic film (patient_image_000012); up to 6 teeth each
method: single-detection backward pass on the deployed signed models, P3-P5 neck layers, maps normalised per layer
decision: Deployed explanation maps use LayerCAM weighting (Jiang et al., LayerCAM: Exploring Hierarchical Class Activation Maps for Localization, IEEE TIP 2021).
script: per-film loop over analysis_service.locate_teeth + YOLOGradCAM._forward with both weightings
